---
name: Source submission
about: Propose an upstream source and explain which claims it can support.
---

## Source and revision

Provide the publisher, title, stable link or identifier, edition or revision, and relevant sections or artifacts.

## Relevance and authority

Identify the domain, records, or claims this source could support. Explain the source's authority for those claims and how it relates to sources already cited.

## Access and reuse

Describe access constraints and known terms that affect reuse or redistribution. Include a link to the source terms where available.

## Limits or conflicts

Record known gaps, uncertainty, or disagreement with other evidence.
